From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@avalonhealth.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@avalonhealth.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T15:03:00-08:00
Subject: Avalon — Follow-up: CAIQ session notes + evidence handoff

Hi Samira / Tom — thanks for the productive session today. Notes and next steps below (quick summary followed by Q&A excerpts and action owners).

Quick summary:
- We reviewed the CAIQ draft and identified 18 items likely to require evidentiary artifacts. Those are marked in the spreadsheet (tab: EVIDENCE-REQUIRED).
- On logging: Redwood can provide anonymized API request samples (fields: timestamp, request_id, model_id, user_id (hashed), response_size_bytes). We cannot share user PII; we'll provide a data mapping of fields we redact.
- Data residency: no inference processing occurs outside the US for Avalon’s configured region (confirmed).
- IAM attestation: Redwood provides quarterly access review reports; format is CSV export from our identity provider.

Q&A excerpts (verbatim when helpful):
Samira asked: "Can you provide a 7-day sample of API requests that includes timestamps and request IDs?"
> Ava: "Yes — we can provide a 7-day anonymized sample. We will hash user_id and remove any PII fields; you'll get a field list beforehand for approval."

Tom asked: "Are there existing change-control tickets we can review for the last two releases?"
> Marissa: "We'll share the PR/issue links and a redacted changelog; tickets will be provided as read-only links where possible."

Action items and owners:
- Redwood: Produce anonymized 7-day API sample (attachment: evidence-handoff-checklist.csv will enumerate fields) — Owner: Ava Chen — Due: 2026-11-17
- Avalon: Identify internal owner for IAM attestation delivery and confirm export format — Owner: Samira Khan — Due: 2026-11-12
- Redwood: Share PR/issue redacted links for last two releases (read-only) — Owner: Marissa Cole — Due: 2026-11-13
- Redwood Security: Provide a short memo on retention windows and where logs are stored (S3 bucket naming patterns) — Owner: Kimberly Park — Due: 2026-11-15

Attachments provided with this thread: [evidence-handoff-checklist.csv] (checklist + expected field list), [redwood_soc2_logging_guidance.pdf]
Drive artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AvaAvalonAssurance
HubSpot: HS-4821

If this looks right, we'll convert the action items into Jira tickets and share estimates for producing the samples. Thanks again — we'll keep the thread updated as artifacts are uploaded.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success (Compliance Lead)
Redwood Inference
